note: §2.1 candidate 1: real agent traffic in repositories I did not build. The repos are docs/30's roster at pinned revisions; the tasks are `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items their own authors wrote in the repositories' markdown. The shipped gate runs in --dry-run so it records a verdict for every Bash command without changing what the agent does.

calls.command: cat TODO.md 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find . -name "*.mbt" -not -path "./target/*" | xargs grep -l "concurrency" -i 2>/dev/null
grep -n -i "concurrency" src/parser.mbt src/lib.mbt src/lowering.mbt src/lib_test.mbt src/compat_docs_test.mbt src/e2e/main/main.mbt
grep -n -i "cancel" src/executor.mbt src/lib.mbt src/runtime.mbt src/plan_api.mbt src/store_protocol.mbt 2>/dev/null | head -80
wc -l src/executor.mbt src/lib.mbt src/parser.mbt src/lowering.mbt src/lib_test.mbt src/compat_docs_test.mbt src/e2e/main/main.mbt TODO.md 2>/dev/null
grep -n -i "run_workflow\|fn run\b\|pub fn execute\|fn execute" src/executor.mbt | head -40
grep -rn "struct FlowIr\|struct FlowJob\|struct FlowTask\|struct FlowNode" src/*.mbt

grep -rn "^import\|moonbitlang\|@wf" src/lowering.mbt | head -5; grep -n "\"wf\"\|package.*wf\|import.*flow" src/moon.pkg 2>/dev/null; find /tmp/jev-wild-UTSR9K -iname "*.mbt" | xargs grep -l "struct FlowIr\|struct FlowJob\|struct FlowTask" 2>/dev/null
cat src/moon.pkg | grep -A3 -B3 "wf\b" 2>/dev/null; find /tmp/jev-wild-UTSR9K -path "*/wf/*" -o -iname "wf" -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules
grep -n "^pub fn\|^fn \|^async fn\|^pub async fn" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt | head -80
grep -n "^pub fn run_workflow\|^async fn run_workflow_cmd\|fn cmd_workflow_run\|async fn cmd_run\b\|fn cmd_run(" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt
grep -n "fn evaluate_job_outputs\|fn evaluate_expression_value\|fn resolve_expr\|fn evaluate_env_value\|\"\\${{\"\|expr_value\|fn extract_expression" src/executor.mbt | head -30
grep -n "^fn evaluate\|^pub fn evaluate\|^async fn evaluate" src/executor.mbt src/if_condition.mbt
grep -n "fn evaluate_step_output_expression\|fn resolve_step_output\|step_output_expr_name\|fn evaluate_matrix\|fn substitute_matrix_text" src/executor.mbt src/lowering.mbt | head -20
find . -maxdepth 2 -iname "docs" -o -iname "DESIGN*.md" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules; grep -rn "concurrency" README.mbt.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null | head -20
ls docs/ | grep -i concurr; grep -rln "concurrency" docs/ testdata/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -n -i "concurrency" -A5 -B5 docs/advanced-workflow.md; echo ---; cat testdata/docs/concurrency-parse/workflow.yml; echo ---; cat testdata/docs/concurrency-parse/fixture.txt
grep -rn "\.environment\b" src/executor.mbt src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt src/lowering.mbt 2>/dev/null | grep -v "runner_environment\|RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" | head -20
cat src/moon.pkg && echo --- && grep -rn "process_native\|@process\|import.*process" src/moon.pkg src/process_native.mbt | head -30
grep -n "job_matrix_groups\|job_matrix_fail_fast\|struct FlowIr\|pub struct FlowIr" src/lowering.mbt | head -40

cat moon.mod 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*mooncakes*" 2>/dev/null; echo ---; moon --version 2>&1; echo ---; find / -path "*moonbitlang/async*" -name "*.mbti" 2>/dev/null | grep -v jev-wild-clones

which just 2>&1; echo ---; cat /tmp/jev-wild-UTSR9K/justfile 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; find / -maxdepth 3 -iname "*moon*" -type d 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls -la ~/.moon 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 5 -iname "moon" -type f 2>/dev/null
npm view moonbit 2>&1 | head -5; echo ---; npm search moonbit 2>&1 | head -20
